entries.zh: 纵马疾驰；放松缰绳任马奔跑
entries.en: at full gallop; with loosened reins (a las bridas)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「威實」与「放缰奔驰」对不上，音义均难相合，仅据西语词头定夺。

entries.zh: 贺喜；道喜（亦指报喜所得的赏钱）
entries.en: congratulations; a present or reward for good news (albricias)

entries.zh: 媒人；婚事撮合者（引申指拉皮条的人）
entries.en: matchmaker; marriage go-between; by extension a pimp (alcahuete)

entries.zh: 做媒；居中撮合（男女私情），牵线拉皮条
entries.en: to act as matchmaker or go-between; to procure for an illicit affair
entries.notes: H 栏「牽門縩」字形有疑，M 栏音写与「牽媒做」相合，故义从媒合、牵线。

entries.zh: 私通；暗中往来、居中传递（男女私情的内应）
entries.en: secret liaison; clandestine go-between in an illicit affair
entries.notes: L 为 alcahuete 之异写，H「內通」偏指暗中勾连，义取「私通、内应」。

entries.zh: 官；长官（alcayde 指城堡或监狱之长官）
entries.en: official; magistrate; governor or warden (alcayde)

entries.zh: 狱官；典狱长；亦指大长官（alcayde mayor）
entries.en: prison warden; jail governor; also chief magistrate (alcayde mayor)
entries.notes: L 栏「uoms」漫漶，疑为「aun」；义据「狱官」及 alcayde de la cárcel 定。

entries.zh: 狱卒；地狱的看守（亦比作捕役、差役）
entries.en: jailer; warder of hell; also likened to a bailiff or constable (alguacil)
entries.notes: M 栏声调符号污损（T99），字面与 H「獄卒」尚清，义仍可定。

entries.zh: 攀；向上够取（高处之物）
entries.en: to reach up; to climb up to something on high

entries.zh: 扳落来；把高处之物拉下来
entries.en: to pull down something from on high

entries.zh: 攀摘；攀爬采摘（果实）
entries.en: to climb up and pick fruit

entries.zh: 得；达到所图求的目标
entries.en: to attain what one aims at; to obtain one's object
entries.notes: H 栏字形作「浔（潯）」而 M、R 两栏音写均与「得」相合，疑为「得」之形误。

entries.zh: 得力；获得帮助、助力（favor, ayuda）
entries.en: to get help; to obtain favour or succour
entries.notes: 同上条，H 首字疑为「得」，与西语 favor/ayuda 及 M、R 音写相合，读作「得力」。

entries.zh: 扑灭；消除（账目上勾销、了结）
entries.en: to extinguish, wipe out; in accounts, to strike off or cancel
entries.notes: L「alcançar en la quenta」与 H「撲滅」对应牵强，疑指账目勾销，未能定夺。

entries.zh: 到手；如愿获得（所渴望者）
entries.en: to get into one's hands; to obtain what one desires

entries.zh: 追赶；跑着追及（次要义：赶走）
entries.en: to pursue; to catch up with by running; also to drive away
entries.notes: M 栏声调污损（T99）；L 文句别扭，义取「趕」（追）与「走」（跑）之合。

entries.zh: 赶上；追着（某人）
entries.en: to catch up with; to overtake someone
entries.notes: M 栏声调污损（T99）；L「iendo hazer」语义含混，义据「趕着」定。

entries.zh: 应允；答应（所请求之事或付款）
entries.en: to consent to; to grant what is asked, or the payment

entries.zh: 应得；获得所应得、所求之物
entries.en: to get one's due; to obtain what is asked for

entries.zh: 求得；恳求而获得
entries.en: to obtain by entreaty; to gain by asking
